author: MLGtino
body:
I'm presuming this is already suggested, but can we have:

Kit: Grappler
Loadout: Leather chestplate, leather pants, gold boots.
Stone sword
Grappling hook (fishing rod) - 10 uses. It can be used for 2 purposes. 
1: Grappling away (unreeling your rod, grappling on to something like the ground, a mountain, etc).
2: Tagging people with your hook and right clicking to teleport them to you.

Feedback? (I was bored so lets work off of this awful suggestion until we get somewhere)


FOR NEXUS ARACHADONIC.

NEXUS o/
